# Astronomical 0.2.79
## What's new
- **Folded ternary model family support.** Astronomical now serves the `prism_hadamard_qwen35` family from the folded ternary 27B pack (`prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-mlx-2bit`): streaming chat completions, greedy and sampled, through the resident serving stack, with the family's full acceptance journeys — upstream greedy parity replay and five performance tiers. - **Faster replies from the folded ternary pack.** Decode optimizations across this release — one Hadamard rotation per activation, one-token-ahead pipelined decode, fused sibling projections, and fused rate-activation and head-normalization launches — raise decode throughput while the model's output stays bit-for-bit unchanged. - **New `doctor` command-line verb.** A read-only diagnostic that reports channel binding and daemon liveness, so a broken command-line path explains itself. - **Clearer daemon-not-running errors.** The message now names the channel and the sockets that were probed. - **Dependency and tooling refresh**, with no configuration format changes and no removed settings.
## Compatibility
- macOS 14.0 and later on Apple silicon (arm64). - Existing configuration, state, and installed models are preserved; no migration is required.
## Distribution
- The application and every nested executable are signed with Astronomical's Developer ID Application certificate (Hardened Runtime, timestamped), and the disk image is notarized with Apple and carries a stapled notarization ticket. - Existing installs receive this update through the signed Sparkle feed; new installs download `Astronomical-0.2.79-macOS-arm64.dmg` from the releases page.
